description: This file defines the main Smarty class for the Smarty PHP template engine, including constants, properties, and methods for template management, security, plugin loading, and configuration.

classes.name: Smarty
classes.description: Main class for the Smarty PHP template engine, managing templates, configuration, security, plugins, and rendering.

methods.name: addTemplateDir
methods.description: Adds one or more template directories.

methods.name: createTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new template object for rendering.

methods.name: _getTemplateId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a template based on its name and parameters.

methods.name: _realpath
methods.description: Normalizes and converts a path to an absolute or relative path.

methods.name: setUseSubDirs
methods.description: Sets whether to use subdirectories for compiled/cached files.

methods.name: setEscapeHtml
methods.description: Enables or disables HTML escaping for variables.

methods.name: setForceCompile
methods.description: Enables or disables forced template compilation.

methods.name: setMergeCompiledIncludes
methods.description: Enables or disables merging of compiled includes.

methods.name: getLeftDelimiter
methods.description: Retrieves the left delimiter for templates.

methods.name: setLeftDelimiter
methods.description: Sets the left delimiter for templates.

methods.name: getRightDelimiter
methods.description: Retrieves the right delimiter for templates.

methods.name: setRightDelimiter
methods.description: Sets the right delimiter for templates.

methods.name: setConfigOverwrite
methods.description: Sets whether config variables overwrite each other.

methods.name: setConfigBooleanize
methods.description: Sets whether config values are booleanized.

methods.name: setConfigReadHidden
methods.description: Sets whether hidden config sections/vars are read.

methods.name: testInstall
methods.description: Runs a test installation of Smarty.
